I started in Sri Lanka, running social media and events for an education institute and managing 200+ client accounts at a finance company. Since moving to Canada I've spent most of my time on the parts of marketing that involve finding out what people actually want and turning that into something they'll respond to.

That has meant surveying 136 students to shape a startup pitch, rebranding a campus club and watching the following grow, setting up analytics where there were none, and organizing a fundraiser that brought in over $1,000 in a day. I like work where you can see the number move.

SubZero at GATE 101 Startup Boot Camp

Solo founder · March 2026

SubZero is an app that helps people optimize their subscriptions: it flags what they're paying for, suggests cheaper alternatives, and shows what they'd save by switching. The primary target market was students.

I ran primary research with 136 students to validate the problem and shape the pitch, then presented to a panel and an audience of around 50 people. Made it to the finale competing against team-based entries.

Enactus UofR rebrand

Co-VP Marketing · May 2026 – present

I initiated a full rebrand for the 2026–27 year: new colours, a new typeface, and a redesigned logo with a gradient, rolled out across every campus and community channel. Following grew 18% in the first two and a half months.

I lead a 10-person marketing team covering social media, events, and behind-the-scenes storytelling, and run the marketing for six social enterprise projects:

  • Elevate XP — a startup accelerator for high school students, who build a business, get mentored by professionals, and pitch for sponsorship.
  • Nurturaa — AI-powered supply chain intelligence that helps food banks and non-profits buy smarter and cut food waste.
  • Newruva — turns agricultural and food waste into biochar.
  • Regrounds — combines spent coffee grounds from local cafés with flax straw and hemp shive from prairie farms into a durable composite, made into cups, bowls, and homewares.
  • Rootspeak — Duolingo for Indigenous languages.
  • Offklass — an AI learning platform for students without reliable internet access.

I also set up a GA4 account for the club website so we can see what's working instead of guessing.
